title: Discovery Children's Museum

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Come play and learn with us this summer! Bring your curiosity and sense of wonder as you join Museum Educators for brain-boosting camps that focus on STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Math) activities! With a diverse range of camps tailored for curious minds of all ages, DISCOVERY Children’s Museum is your destination for educational summer fun! Whether they’re budding scientists, aspiring artists, or future engineers, there’s a place for every curious mind at DISCOVERY Children’s Museum.
